articles.title: EU entity suspected of losing $106 million from crypto exchange accounts, ZachXBT says
articles.snippet: The unidentified attacker moved funds through ether, instant exchanges and Monero, but the victim and affected exchanges remain unknown.

articles.title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
articles.snippet: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

articles.title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
articles.snippet: ZEC led the majors and oil slid on a report that Trump wants to give Iran diplomacy more time, with U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.

articles.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
articles.snippet: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

articles.title: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents
articles.snippet: Who better to judge a dispute between AI agents than a jury of different AI models? That’s the idea behind GenLayer, which is already issuing thousands of judgements each day.
